_help: To add a product, copy one block, change the fields, and put your Amazon link in 'url'. category must be Protein, Supplements or Gear. Leave 'image' empty to show an icon. Set 'enabled' to true when the link is real.

products.title: MuscleBlaze Biozyme Iso-Zero Whey Protein Isolate, 1 kg

products.title: TrueBasics Clean Whey Protein (Isolate + Concentrate)
products.note: My pick for a whey that is light on the gut. It is easy to digest and gentle on the stomach.
